violations.finding: Hardcoded CDN URLs for React 18, ReactDOM 18, and Babel standalone embedded in HTML_HEAD string constant: unpkg.com/react@18/..., unpkg.com/react-dom@18/..., unpkg.com/@babel/standalone/babel.min.js
violations.recommendation: Parameterize CDN asset URLs via config/env/generator args, or vendor assets locally. Example: accept --cdn-react/--cdn-babel flags or read from a config file.

violations.finding: Chinese character string '\u9910\u996e' (dining category keyword) embedded in Python source as a matcher key in _is_dining_cat(). Script files must be English-only; bilingual data keys are not explicitly exempt.
violations.recommendation: Move localized category keywords to an external locale data file or constant dictionary. In the Python source, reference an English identifier (e.g. DINING_CATEGORY_ZH) defined in a data module.

codex_consult.feedback_summary: Codex confirmed: (1) Standard 3 docstring finding is a false positive — not flagged. (2) Chinese character in render_html_builders.py:29 should be reported under Standard 6, no bilingual-key exemption exists. (3) .tpl scope ambiguity — decided as out-of-scope per strict standard definition. (4) CDN URLs in render_html_builders.py:328-330 are a real Standard 2 violation (not merely debatable). (5) Same URLs also implicate Standard 9 — but both are pre-existing (absent from this cycle's diff hunk). (6) MEAL_SLOT_IDS duplication in web/js/ is out-of-scope for Standard 7. (7) All violations are critical severity.

findings.issue: Standard 3 false positive on docstring usage line in serve-trip.py
findings.rationale: Agreed — docstring example is not an executable invocation. Not flagged.

findings.issue: Standard 6 Chinese character in render_html_builders.py:29 should be reported; no bilingual-key exemption in standard definition
findings.proposed_fix: Move localized matcher tokens to external locale/config data; reference English identifier in Python source
findings.rationale: The standard has no explicit exemption. Character is pre-existing in this file (present in HEAD~1, not introduced by this diff). Violation is reported with introduced_in_diff: false.

findings.issue: Scope ambiguity on .tpl file for Standard 6
findings.proposed_fix: Decide scope explicitly; if in-scope, externalize UI labels to locale data
findings.rationale: Applied strict scope definition: Standard 6 lists scripts/*.sh and scripts/*.py. The .tpl file is neither. Recorded as out-of-scope observation.

findings.issue: CDN URLs in render_html_builders.py:328-330 are a definite Standard 2 violation, not merely debatable
findings.proposed_fix: Parameterize React/ReactDOM/Babel asset URLs via config/env/generator args, or use local vendored assets
findings.rationale: Codex is correct. The URLs are hardcoded and match Standard 2's explicit hardcoded-URL pattern. Reported. Pre-existing (not in this cycle's diff hunk — git diff shows NO_CDN_DIFF), so introduced_in_diff: false.

findings.issue: Same CDN URLs also implicate Standard 9 (parameterized-scripts) since CDN host/version can differ by environment
findings.rationale: The CDN URLs are in a constant (HTML_HEAD) inside a Python library module, not a script entrypoint. Standard 9 targets scripts that accept parameters for variable values at runtime. A library module's HTML template constant is distinct from a script's runtime-variable values. Additionally the violation is pre-existing. Logged as observation, not added as separate finding to avoid duplicate.

findings.issue: MEAL_SLOT_IDS/_isCompatible() duplicated between web/js/drag.js and web/js/mobile.js — Standard 7 concern
findings.proposed_fix: Extract shared slot compatibility helper to web/js/slot-compat.js
findings.rationale: Standard 7 scope covers scripts/ directory only. web/js/ is outside Standard 7 scope by standard definition. Recorded as out-of-scope observation.

findings.issue: All style-inspector violations must be critical severity
findings.rationale: All reported violations are tagged critical per standard.

codex_consult.feedback_incorporated: Two violations reported (Standard 2 CDN URLs confirmed as real violation, Standard 6 Chinese character confirmed as reportable). Standard 3 false positive not flagged. .tpl out-of-scope confirmed. web/js/ Standard 7 out-of-scope confirmed. Both violations tagged introduced_in_diff: false (pre-existing in HEAD~1).
